enacted_as: Proposition 7 (November 5, 1974) — reorganization of California Declaration of Rights
notes: Section 7 was added by Proposition 7 as part of the 1974 reorganization of Article I. Subdivision (a) provides due process and equal protection guarantees. Subdivision (b) provides a privileges or immunities clause prohibiting legislative favoritism. Leginfo annotation confirms: 'Sec. 7 added Nov. 5, 1974, by Prop. 7; Res.Ch. 90, 1974.' Subdivision (a) was subsequently amended by Proposition 1 (November 6, 1979) adding school-assignment language. Subdivision (b) has never been amended.
